decision.reason: The only evidence is the two install.yaml manifests [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2], and their excerpts show nothing beyond "apiVersion: v1". They show no part of the HelmRepository v1beta2 schema, so they cannot confirm whether status.artifact itself is optional or whether status is a subresource. The changed path is under status, which the controller writes rather than the operator. Without the schema, the evidence cannot show that operator-applied HelmRepository objects are rejected, so the fact's resource-rejected (action-required) consequence may over-claim. To decide, we need the CRD schema excerpts for status.artifact (its required list and parent optionality) and the subresources stanza from both versions.
